snippet.title: Ravenswatch | Merlin Reveal Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Merlin now on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3607950/Ravenswatch__Merlin/

Our first new character DLC, Merlin, is coming in January 2026.
Master of multiple schools of magic, he bends Nature, Arcane, and Sacred spells to reshape the battlefield.

Merlin will join the Ravenswatch in January 2026 on Steam, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch.

PlayStation ► https://store.playstation.com/fr-fr/concept/10005682
